kids.t: Kampala Special Hire — Sedan or SUV
Private driver on call for hourly hire around Kampala in a sedan or suv.
Uganda's capital — dining, culture, and the jumping-off point for most itineraries.
Kampala is where most itineraries start and end: a hub for dining, culture, craft markets, and reliable airport/city transport connections.
Use verified transport after dark and keep valuables secure in busy markets.
